summary.name: Wireshark
summary.one_liner: Wireshark is a free, open-source network protocol analyzer that captures and interactively browses traffic on a computer network.
summary.what_it_does: Wireshark lets users capture and interactively browse the traffic running on a computer network. It provides deep inspection of hundreds of protocols. The source code is available under the GNU General Public License version 2. The page says the full version is downloadable without a license fee, with no demo limitations. Documentation, a Learn page, and YouTube tutorials are linked from the site.
notable: Deep inspection of hundreds of network protocols
Open source under GNU GPL v2
Maintained by the non-profit Wireshark Foundation
Current old stable release 4.4.19 and development release 5.0.0rc1
caveats: Development release 5.0.0rc1 is a release candidate, not a stable build
Platforms beyond Windows, macOS, Linux and UNIX require building from source
